newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani bourse closed for holiday on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani bourse closed for holiday on Tuesday.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange will remain closed on Tuesday because of a religious holiday, the bourse said in a statement.
Trading was scheduled to resume on Wednesday, according to the statement which was dated Monday, before President Farooq Leghari dissolved parliament and sacked Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto.

On Monday, the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 40.81 points, or 2.80 percent, to end at 1,499.97. Shares soared amid blue-chip buying powered by a rise in synthetic fibre prices and some favourable corporate results.
